_: Not a gate, and not a reference value. This is history: the sha256 values that
identical inputs have actually produced, for one pinned submodule revision.
wasm.yml no longer compares against them, because two from-scratch builds of
one recipe — no build cache, toolchain identical, cache miss proven in the log
— produce different bytes. The build is not reproducible, so a digest cannot
be a gate: it identifies a build, it does not guarantee one.
Kept because eight distinct outputs from one source is the evidence for the
upstream report in wasm/upstream-report.md, and evidence is the point.
Keyed by <submodule revision>:<recipe hash>. The same revision appears under
two recipe hashes because the recipe changed during the investigation.
